title: The Renewal Evidence Packet
subtitle: Make the forecast inspectable before you ask the business to trust it.
intro_text: Complete this packet for one renewal before the forecast review. Label the quality and freshness of every item, record contrary evidence, then decide whether the current forecast state can be defended. This is a decision aid, not a prediction guarantee.
scoring_note: Do not total these sections into a probability. Use the packet to identify missing or stale evidence and apply your own documented promotion rules.
closing_quote: Confidence belongs in the forecast only when the evidence can survive inspection.
next_action: Choose one renewal currently marked Commit. Complete all sections, challenge its weakest evidence, and record whether to retain, promote, demote, or unverify the forecast.

sections.title: Contract Reality and Decision Path
sections.why_it_matters: A correct renewal date does not prove that the buying path, scope, or approvals are understood.
sections.review_prompt: Which missing or stale item could change the renewal scope, date, or buying path?
rows: Available-to-renew scope, expected scope, known change
Renewal date, notice period, and customer decision date
Remaining budget, security, procurement, legal, and signature steps
Owner and expected date for every remaining step

sections.title: Customer Authority and Value Proof
sections.why_it_matters: A champion's enthusiasm and internal usage analysis are not substitutes for decision authority or customer-recognised value.
sections.review_prompt: Which authority or value claim is still only internally asserted?
rows: Budget owner, approver, blocker, operator, and champion
Last direct interaction with every critical role
Outcome the customer intended to achieve

sections.title: Risk, Response, and Contrary Evidence
sections.why_it_matters: A credible packet makes uncertainty and disconfirming facts visible instead of averaging them into sentiment.
sections.review_prompt: What contrary evidence most weakens the current forecast, and who will test it?
rows: Uncertain event, source, and potential effect
Do not record a mood as a risk
Action, owner, and next evidence date
Name the decision the action should change
Facts that weaken scope, timing, intent, or value
Never leave blank; write none found
Information still required to defend the forecast

sections.title: Evidence Register and Forecast Decision
sections.why_it_matters: Quality and freshness determine whether an evidence item should influence today's forecast.
sections.review_prompt: Does the current state survive the evidence test: retain, promote, demote, or unverify?
rows: Source date; expiry date; stale yes or no
Use intervals defined for your business
Unverified; Evidence building; Credible path; Commit; Closed
